# Ichikara

> Generated by docmd

## Overview

- [Ichikara](https://audiflo.github.io/Ichikara/docs/)
  A OneVoice song editor and TypeScript singing-synthesis library.

## API

- [DSP Primitives](https://audiflo.github.io/Ichikara/docs/api/dsp/)
  Low-level digital signal processing components
- [Import / Export](https://audiflo.github.io/Ichikara/docs/api/import-export/)
  Native projects and score conversion through UtaFormatix.
- [API Reference](https://audiflo.github.io/Ichikara/docs/api/)
  Public types and functions for synthesis, projects, playback, and score conversion.
- [Native projects](https://audiflo.github.io/Ichikara/docs/api/projects/)
  Create, validate, save, and render multi-track Ichikara songs.
- [VoiceConfig Reference](https://audiflo.github.io/Ichikara/docs/api/voice-config/)
  Complete reference for all VoiceConfig parameters and their perceptual effects

- [Development checks](https://audiflo.github.io/Ichikara/docs/development/)

## Getting Started

- [Core Concepts](https://audiflo.github.io/Ichikara/docs/getting-started/concepts/)
  Understand how Ichikara produces singing voice audio
- [Installation](https://audiflo.github.io/Ichikara/docs/getting-started/installation/)
  Install Ichikara via npm or use it directly in the browser
- [Quick Start](https://audiflo.github.io/Ichikara/docs/getting-started/quickstart/)
  Render a phrase to WAV and play it in the browser.

## Guide

- [Architecture](https://audiflo.github.io/Ichikara/docs/guide/architecture/)
  How the Ichikara library is organised
- [Song editor](https://audiflo.github.io/Ichikara/docs/guide/editor/)
  Arrange vocal tracks, edit notes and expression, and save or render a song.
- [Languages](https://audiflo.github.io/Ichikara/docs/guide/languages/)
  Built-in language support and how to add custom languages
- [Renderer](https://audiflo.github.io/Ichikara/docs/guide/renderer/)
